description: Record one voucher paid out of the tin and return its VOU-YYYY-NNNN number. More than the float holds is refused, and so is a byte-identical duplicate. Free tier: 20 vouchers a calendar month.

amount_minor.description: What was paid out, in whole minor units. 1250 is EUR 12.50

category.description: What kind of spend, e.g. postage, travel, office. It becomes the expenses:<category> account

date.description: The date the cash left the tin, YYYY-MM-DD

description.description: What was bought, e.g. Printer paper x5

duplicate_ok.description: Record it even though an identical voucher exists, for a genuinely repeated purchase. Default false

float.description: The float id, e.g. FLOAT-2026-0001, or its name. Omit when there is only one

paid_to.description: Who was paid, e.g. Corner Shop

receipt_ref.description: The receipt number or where the paper is filed

name: voucher_add
title: Record a petty cash voucher
